blocks.en: Hauling is the practice of moving cargo from one place to another. Due to limited cargo hold sizes and travel times, moving things in EVE can be a time consuming and, in some places, dangerous business. Some players specialize in hauling, whether to move goods from one market to another or to bring supplies and ships to the staging ground for a null sec alliance. This can be done for its own purposes or can be done on behalf of others in exchange for ISK rewards via the contracting system. This can be a very viable way to make ISK for medium-skilled players.
blocks.zh: 运输（Hauling）就是把货物从一个地方运到另一个地方。由于货柜舱容量有限、航行耗时，在 EVE 里搬东西可能既费时间，在某些地方还很危险。有些玩家专门从事运输，无论是把货物从一个市场运到另一个市场，还是把补给和舰船送到 00 区联盟的集结地。运输既可以为自己服务，也可以通过合同系统替别人运货来换取 ISK 报酬。对技能中等的玩家来说，这是一个非常可行的赚钱方式。

blocks.en: This page describes how to carry cargo (hauling) in EVE. For specific advice on moving your own items, see moving your items.
blocks.zh: 本页介绍在 EVE 中如何运送货物（运输）。关于搬运自己物品的具体建议，请参见搬运你的物品。

blocks.en: Hauling craft
blocks.zh: 运输舰船

blocks.en: There are a few classes of ships designed for hauling. Each fills a type of niche, and what ship to use depends on the type of hauling.
blocks.zh: 有几类舰船是专为运输设计的。每一类都有自己的定位，具体用哪艘船取决于运输的类型。

blocks.en: Haulers
blocks.zh: 运载舰

blocks.en: Main article: Haulers
blocks.zh: 主条目：运载舰

blocks.en: The first hauling ships a player can use are Tech 1 Haulers. These are relatively cheap and fast and can haul a moderate amount of cargo. They are however also very fragile and can be destroyed by just one ganker if the cargo they carry is valuable enough. These ships can be sorted into three different classes:
blocks.zh: 玩家最早能用的运输船是T1（一级科技）运载舰。它们相对便宜、速度快，能运送中等数量的货物。但它们也非常脆弱，如果装的货物足够值钱，一个自杀式攻击者就能把它打爆。这些船可以分为三类：

en: Fast transports, which are used to move low-volume, high-value goods quickly and safely.
Bulk transports, which have a much higher capacity than the fast transports, but are slower and have less tank
Specialized transports, which are similar to bulk transports in terms of tank and agility, but have very large cargoholds that can carry only one type of item (such as ammunition or minerals)
zh: 快速运输舰，用于快速、安全地运送体积小、价值高的货物。
大容量运输舰，容量比快速运输舰大得多，但速度更慢，坦度也更低
专用运输舰，坦度和灵活性与大容量运输舰相近，但拥有只能装一种物品（如弹药或矿物）的超大货舱

blocks.en: Haulers have the lowest skill requirements of all hauling craft. Even alpha clones can fly them, though they can only train the Spaceship Command skills to level I.
blocks.zh: 运载舰是所有运输舰船中技能要求最低的。即使是 Alpha 克隆也能驾驶，不过他们只能把飞船操控类技能练到 1 级。

blocks.en: Blockade Runners
blocks.zh: 偷运舰

blocks.en: Main article: Blockade Runners
blocks.zh: 主条目：偷运舰

blocks.en: Blockade runners are Tech 2 haulers. They are the fastest and most agile hauling ship by quite a margin. They can align as quickly as a frigate, are some of the fastest ships in EVE at warp speeds, and even at sub-light speeds they can fly as quickly as a fast cruiser. Additionally, they can fit covert ops cloaking devices (and hence can warp while cloaked). This means that the only real danger to a properly fitted and flown blockade runner are the warp disruption bubbles in nullsec and w-space. With "The Great Escape" update, released May 18, 2021, Blockade Runners are at least somewhat protected from these, as well, by fitting an Interdiction Nullifier.
blocks.zh: 偷运舰是 T2 运载舰。它们是速度最快、最灵活的运输舰，而且领先幅度相当大。它们的对准速度和护卫舰一样快，跃迁速度在 EVE 中名列前茅，即使在亚光速下也能飞得和快速巡洋舰一样快。此外，它们可以装配隐秘行动隐形装置（因此可以隐形跃迁）。这意味着，对一艘装配得当、驾驶得当的偷运舰来说，唯一真正的危险是 00 区和虫洞空间里的跃迁扰断泡。随着 2021 年 5 月 18 日发布的“大逃亡”（The Great Escape）更新，偷运舰也可以通过装配拦截失效装置，在一定程度上防范扰断泡。

blocks.en: They can carry a little less cargo than the Tech 1 fast transports, but can be fitted to carry up to about 10,000 m3 of cargo (enough to carry a packaged cruisers) at the cost of reduced agility and/or speed.
blocks.zh: 它们的载货量比 T1 快速运输舰略少，但通过装配可以运载约 10,000 m3 的货物（足以装下一艘打包的巡洋舰），代价是灵活性和/或速度降低。

blocks.en: Deep Space Transports
blocks.zh: 深层空间运输舰

blocks.en: Main article: Deep Space Transports
blocks.zh: 主条目：深层空间运输舰

blocks.en: Deep Space Transports (DSTs) are tech 2 haulers with larger cargo capacities than their tech 1 equivalents and fleet hangars that hold 50,000 m3 (increased by skills). They have bonuses to active tanking, either shield resistances or armor resistances, helping them to fit substantial buffer tanks. Finally, they get a unique role bonus of 100% to overheating benefits of Afterburners, Microwarpdrives, Local Repair Modules, and Resistance Modules.
blocks.zh: 深层空间运输舰（DST）是 T2 运载舰，货舱容量比对应的 T1 船更大，还有容量 50,000 m3（可通过技能提升）的舰队机库。它们拥有主动防御加成，分为护盾抗性或装甲抗性加成，有助于装配可观的缓冲坦。此外，它们还有一项独特的特有加成：加力燃烧器、微型跃迁推进器、本地维修装备和抗性装备的超载效果提高 100%。

blocks.en: They also have a role bonus of +2 warp strength: this means they can't be tackled by just one warp disruptor or non-faction warp scrambler, though they can still be caught by bubbles, gangs of tacklers, or HICs. The Great Escape update gave Deep Space Transports the ability to fit an Interdiction Nullifier, giving temporary immunity to interdiction bubbles.
blocks.zh: 它们还有 +2 跃迁核心强度的特有加成：这意味着单个跃迁扰断器或非势力版跃迁扰乱器无法拦截它们，不过它们仍然会被扰断泡、成群的拦截船或重型拦截巡洋舰（HIC）抓住。“大逃亡”更新让深层空间运输舰可以装配拦截失效装置，从而暂时免疫拦截扰断泡。

blocks.en: Where blockade runners are meant to rely on speed and stealth to slip by the enemy, deep space transports are designed to bust their way through the enemy, relying on their warp strength and tanking abilities to escape. This probably won't work against a determined and well-prepared gatecamp, and using a deep space transport indicates to all and sundry that you have cargo you want to protect, so you should think carefully before deploying one.
blocks.zh: 偷运舰靠速度和隐身从敌人身边溜过去，而深层空间运输舰则是设计用来硬闯的，依靠跃迁核心强度和坦度逃脱。面对一个意志坚决、准备充分的星门蹲守，这招多半不管用，而且开深层空间运输舰等于向所有人宣告你有需要保护的货物，所以在使用之前要仔细考虑。

blocks.en: Freighters
blocks.zh: 货舰

blocks.en: Main article: Freighters
blocks.zh: 主条目：货舰

blocks.en: Freighters are the ultimate cargo carrying ships, with vast cargo holds. They are often seen flying between high sec trading hubs. All freighters have no high, mid, or rig slots but do have 3 low slots, with restrictive CPU and powergrid to limit the available modules with a role bonus to Reinforced Bulkheads. Freighters also can use Inertial Stabilizers and Nanofiber Internal Structures to increase their agility. Otherwise, a freighter pilot's only other way of enhancing their ship's performance is via hardwiring implants.
blocks.zh: 货舰是终极的载货船，拥有巨大的货舱。经常能看到它们往返于高安的交易中心之间。所有货舰都没有高槽、中槽和改装件槽，但有 3 个低槽，CPU 和能量栅格都很紧张，限制了可用的装备，同时有强化舱隔壁的特有加成。货舰也可以使用惯性稳定器和纳米纤维内部构架来提高灵活性。除此之外，货舰驾驶员提升舰船性能的唯一途径就是硬连接植入体。

blocks.en: Use Freighters for huge cargo through high sec and very short distances into low sec. These require proper support (someone to web for faster aligns, scouts, preferably some EW).
blocks.zh: 货舰适合在高安运送大量货物，或者短距离进入低安。这需要适当的支援（有人给你上停滞网以加快对准、侦察，最好还有一些电子战）。

blocks.en: The four Tech 1 freighters are good for carrying very large amounts of cargo in high security space. They align and warp too slowly to be safely used in lowsec or nullsec. Freighters are very tough, but they are definitely not immune to suicide ganking -- organised and prepared groups of gankers can and do kill freighters.
blocks.zh: 四艘 T1 货舰很适合在高安空间运送非常大量的货物。它们的对准和跃迁太慢，在低安或 00 区使用并不安全。货舰非常耐打，但绝不是对自杀式攻击免疫——有组织、有准备的自杀式攻击团伙能够、也确实会击毁货舰。

blocks.en: All four racial freighters get 5% bonuses to cargo capacity and velocity per level of their pilot's racial freighter skill (Amarr Freighter, Gallente Freighter, and so on). Since you must train the freighter skill to at least level 1, the base capacity of the ship is only used to calculate the actual capacity. It is worth noting that the Caldari freighters with Caldari Freighter IV can hold more than any other freighter, even with their respective freighter skills trained to 5.
blocks.zh: 四个种族的货舰都可以根据驾驶员对应种族货舰技能（艾玛货舰操作、盖伦特货舰操作等）的等级，每级获得 5% 的货舱容量和速度加成。由于货舰技能至少要练到 1 级，船的基础容量只用于计算实际容量。值得注意的是，加达里货舰在加达里货舰操作 IV 时的容量，比其他任何货舰都大，即使后者的货舰技能练到 5 级也是如此。

blocks.en: The Avalanche is a specialized freighter with a large regular hold, but also a massive Infrastructure Hold while packing actual mid and high slots to give it a much wider array of defensive options.
blocks.zh: 雪崩级是一艘特殊的货舰，拥有较大的普通货舱，还有一个巨大的基础设施舱，同时配备了真正的中槽和高槽，防御手段要丰富得多。

blocks.en: Jump Freighters
blocks.zh: 战略货舰

blocks.en: Main article: Jump Freighters
blocks.zh: 主条目：战略货舰

blocks.en: The Tech 2 versions of freighters, jump freighters, have a reduced cargo capacity but are capable of using cynosural fields to jump long distances. They are also able to use stargates like normal ships. (Since cynosural fields cannot be lit in highsec, jump freighters traveling in highsec have to use stargates.) This makes them ideal supply ships for people who live in nullsec.
blocks.zh: 战略货舰是货舰的 T2 版本，载货量有所减少，但可以利用诱导力场进行远距离跳跃。它们也能像普通舰船一样使用星门。（由于高安无法开启诱导力场，战略货舰在高安中只能走星门。）这使它们成为住在 00 区的玩家的理想补给船。

blocks.en: Jump Freighters are used to carry cargo from the high/low sec border to wherever it is needed in null sec and back again. Caldari freighters are the largest, closely followed by Gallente, then Amarr and lastly Minmatar, which is partially compensated for by lower fuel use. The difference is not large though.
blocks.zh: 战略货舰用于把货物从高安/低安交界处运到 00 区需要的地方，再运回来。加达里的战略货舰容量最大，盖伦特紧随其后，然后是艾玛，最后是米玛塔尔，不过米玛塔尔的燃料消耗更低，部分弥补了这一点。但差距并不大。

blocks.en: Jump freighters have much larger potential tanks than Tech 1 freighters when properly fit, but at the cost of a much reduced cargo bay. All jump freighters can exceed 500,000 EHP in tank, which makes ganking them in highsec extraordinarily difficult and expensive.
blocks.zh: 装配得当时，战略货舰的潜在坦度比 T1 货舰高得多，代价是货舱大大缩小。所有战略货舰的坦度都能超过 500,000 有效 HP（EHP），这使得在高安对它们进行自杀式攻击极其困难且代价高昂。

blocks.en: Orca
blocks.zh: 逆戟鲸级

blocks.en: The Orca offers 5 different cargo holds:
blocks.zh: 逆戟鲸级有 5 种不同的货舱：

en: 30,000 m³ Cargo Hold which can be extended to 90,000+ m³ with skills and modules
200 m³ Drone Bay which hold just drones
40,000 m³ Fleet Hangar which can also hold assembled ships
400,000 m³ Ship Maintenance Bay for assembled ships
150,000 m³ Mining Hold for unrefined mining goods, with additional bonus due to ship skills (Mining, Ice harvesting)
zh: 30,000 m³ 货柜舱，通过技能和装备可扩充到 90,000+ m³
200 m³ 无人机挂舱，只能装无人机
40,000 m³ 舰队机库，也可以装已组装的舰船
400,000 m³ 舰船维护舱，用于存放已组装的舰船
150,000 m³ 采矿舱，用于存放未提炼的采矿产物，并有来自舰船技能的额外加成（采矿、冰矿采集）

blocks.en: All holds, hangars and bays except the Drone Bay can be scanned by a Cargo Scanner. However, due to how cargo scanners work, modules fitted to ships in the Ship Maintenance Bay are not detectable by scanning.
blocks.zh: 除无人机挂舱外，所有货舱、机库都可以被货柜舱扫描设备扫描。不过由于货柜舱扫描设备的工作方式，舰船维护舱内舰船上装配的装备是扫描不出来的。

blocks.en: Defensively, the Orca is able to be fit to do the MWD+Cloak trick, it can use its Shield Links to improve its tanking ability, use an Industrial Core to make an active tank viable and it has means of breaking tackle via drones. This unique combination of options is particularly well suited for high-sec travel, where an active pilot will move around at a pace similar to a DST but with a larger cargo capacity, using cloak to avoid cargo scans, while having a huge tank and the ability to carry a second, fitted ship for quick trips into low/null sec to pick up cargo too risky for the Orca to grab.
blocks.zh: 防御方面，逆戟鲸级可以装配成能使用微跃推进+隐形技巧（MWD+Cloak trick）的配置，可以用护盾链接提升坦度，可以用工业核心让主动坦变得可行，还能通过无人机摆脱拦截。这种独特的组合特别适合在高安中航行：一个在线操作的驾驶员能以与深层空间运输舰相近的速度移动，却拥有更大的载货量，可以用隐形躲避货柜扫描，同时拥有巨大的坦度，还能携带第二艘装配好的船，快速进入低安/00 区，去取那些对逆戟鲸来说风险太高的货物。

blocks.en: However, the Orca requires a completely different skill set than most haulers, particularly in the skills that support the defensive options (links, industrial cores, drones, etc). Its also FAR more expensive than many hauling options, which inherently increases the risk of using such an option.
blocks.zh: 不过，逆戟鲸级需要一套与大多数运输船完全不同的技能，尤其是支持其防御手段的技能（链接、工业核心、无人机等）。它也比许多运输选项贵得多，这本身就增加了使用它的风险。

blocks.en: Other options
blocks.zh: 其他选择

blocks.en: There are situations where a small fast craft is better than a big lumbering beast. These include moving blueprints or other small volume, high value cargo. The best options at this size are nullified travel-fit Interceptors (so-called travel-ceptors), Covert Ops Frigates, and (for highsec/lowsec) the Hecate with a sub-1s align time fit. These can provide near-perfect safety if handled correctly.
blocks.zh: 有些情况下，小而快的船比笨重的大家伙更合适，比如运送蓝图或其他体积小、价值高的货物。这个体积级别下最好的选择是装了失效装置的旅行配置截击舰（所谓的旅行截击舰）、隐形特勤舰，以及（用于高安/低安的）对准时间低于 1 秒配置的赫卡特级。如果操作得当，这些船几乎可以做到绝对安全。

blocks.en: As an alternative, a shuttle (all areas of space) or a fast T1 frigate (in highsec and lowsec) will work as well, but they are more susceptible to smartbombing gatecamps. Tactical bookmarks on-grid with gates ("perches") and insta-dock/insta-undock bookmarks can mitigate this risk considerably. (See Bookmark for an more in-depth explanation.)
blocks.zh: 另外，穿梭机（所有空间区域）或快速的 T1 护卫舰（高安和低安）也可以，但它们更容易被使用立体炸弹的星门蹲守打掉。在星门所在网格上设置战术书签（“栖息点”），以及使用秒进站/秒离站书签，可以大大降低这种风险。（详细说明请参见书签。）

blocks.en: The Sunesis is a special edition destroyer that is given out to all Omega pilots once per year. A sub-2s fit able to hold ~745 m3 is possible (even as an alpha). However, this fit requires extremely expensive implants, therefore is an impractical and/or unnecessary option for most. With no implants, the Sunesis can still achieve a sub-3 second align, whilst retaining a respectable 1300+m3 cargo capacity, if the pilot has trained agility reducing skills.
blocks.zh: 旭日级是一艘特别版驱逐舰，每年会向所有 Omega 驾驶员发放一次。可以（甚至 Alpha 也可以）做出对准时间低于 2 秒、能装约 745 m3 货物的配置。不过这个配置需要极其昂贵的植入体，因此对大多数人来说不切实际，也没有必要。如果驾驶员练了降低灵活性系数的技能，不装植入体的旭日级仍然可以做到对准时间低于 3 秒，同时保留可观的 1300+ m3 载货量。

blocks.en: A Victorieux Luxury Yacht can warp cloaked, ignores nullsec bubbles if fitted with an interdiction nullifier, can be fit with enough tank to survive smartbombs, and has very decent align time and warp speed. That is another good option for moving high-value, low-volume cargo.
blocks.zh: 凯旋奢华游艇可以隐形跃迁，装配拦截失效装置后可以无视 00 区的扰断泡，可以装配足以扛住立体炸弹的坦度，对准时间和跃迁速度也相当不错。这是运送高价值、小体积货物的另一个好选择。

blocks.en: Faction comparison
blocks.zh: 势力对比

blocks.en: Amarr have the largest capacity T1 Haulers but otherwise tend to be outperformed by other races. Minmatar haulers tend to align and fly slightly faster than other factions, but don't sacrifice cargo or tank to do it, making them arguably the best haulers overall. Caldari have the largest capacity freighters, and unquestionably the tankiest T1 haulers. The specialized Gallente T1 haulers (and to a lesser extent the Minmatar ammo hauler) are extremely convenient if you regularly haul ore/minerals/PI/ammo.
blocks.zh: 艾玛拥有容量最大的 T1 运载舰，但其他方面往往不如其他种族。米玛塔尔运载舰的对准和飞行速度通常比其他势力略快，而且没有为此牺牲载货量或坦度，因此可以说是总体上最好的运载舰。加达里拥有容量最大的货舰，T1 运载舰的坦度也毫无疑问是最高的。如果你经常运送矿石/矿物/行星开发产品/弹药，盖伦特的 T1 专用运载舰（以及在较小程度上米玛塔尔的弹药运载舰）会极其方便。

blocks.en: To maximize flexibility, it's recommended that all new haulers train Gallente and Minmatar haulers to at least 3, and from there decide which race to train to 5 depending on what exactly it is you want to do.
blocks.zh: 为了最大程度的灵活性，建议所有新手运输玩家至少把盖伦特和米玛塔尔运载舰练到 3 级，然后再根据自己具体想做什么，决定把哪个种族练到 5 级。

blocks.en: Hauler type comparison
blocks.zh: 运输舰类型对比

blocks.en: The best hauler is situational; it depends on where you are (high, low, null/WH/Pochven) combined with how large and valuable the cargo is. For example, using an Occator (DST) to move a cargo small enough to fit in a Viator (BR) is sub-optimal, as is using a Viator to move large amounts of tritanium around in high sec when you could use a Kryos (T1 hauler specialised for minerals) instead.
blocks.zh: 最好的运输船取决于具体情况：要看你在哪里（高安、低安、00 区/虫洞/波赫文），以及货物的体积和价值。例如，用奥卡托级（深层空间运输舰）去运旅行者级（偷运舰）就能装下的货物是不够理想的；在高安用旅行者级搬运大量三钛合金也同样不理想，因为你可以改用克琉斯级（专门运矿物的 T1 运载舰）。

blocks.en: Below are the optimal ships for each task, assuming that the area that you're going to or through is not a place where it's clearly a bad idea to bring such a ship type and that the cargo value is low enough to be within the recommended limits (in highsec). This does not mean that only these ships can or should be used. (For negligible-volume hauling for example, a Shuttle will do fine in all areas of space, but using an interceptor is better because it gives you more protection against smartbombing gatecamps.) But if training up a toon specifically for hauling duties, these are good goals to work toward.
blocks.zh: 下面列出了各类任务的最佳舰船，前提是你要去或要经过的区域并不是明显不适合带这类船的地方，并且货物价值足够低、在推荐的限度之内（在高安）。这并不意味着只能或只应该用这些船。（例如对于体积可以忽略不计的运输，穿梭机在所有空间区域都没问题，但用截击舰更好，因为它能更好地防范使用立体炸弹的星门蹲守。）但如果你要专门培养一个运输角色，这些都是很好的目标。

en: Cargo with near-negligible volume: Interceptor or Cov-Ops Frigate (anywhere), sub-1s Hecate (highsec/lowsec)
Up to 10,000 m3 (packaged cruiser size) anywhere: Blockade Runner
Low-value cargo up to 15,000 m3 (packaged battlecruiser size) anywhere: Fast T1 Hauler
Low-value cargo up to 30,000 m3 (two packaged battlecruisers size) in highsec: Bulk T1 Hauler, specialised T1 Haulers
Medium-value cargo up to 60,000 m3 (packaged battleship size): Deep Space Transport (anywhere) (if Jump Freighter is not [yet] an option), Orca (highsec)

High-value cargo beyond 10,000 m3 in highsec: Blockade Runner doing several trips (even if you may get the job done faster with a DST, getting it there slowly is better than not getting it there at all due to being ganked)
Huge cargo above ~60k m3 and below ~300k m3 anywhere: Jump Freighter (aligns faster than a Freighter and has more tank)
Huge cargo above ~300k m3 anywhere: Freighter (requires escort in low and null, is easily caught by bubbles/gatecamps), Jump Freighter doing several trips
zh: 体积几乎可以忽略不计的货物：截击舰或隐形特勤舰（任何地方），对准低于 1 秒的赫卡特级（高安/低安）
任何地方最多 10,000 m3（打包巡洋舰大小）：偷运舰
任何地方最多 15,000 m3（打包战列巡洋舰大小）的低价值货物：快速 T1 运载舰
高安中最多 30,000 m3（两艘打包战列巡洋舰大小）的低价值货物：大容量 T1 运载舰、专用 T1 运载舰
最多 60,000 m3（打包战列舰大小）的中等价值货物：深层空间运输舰（任何地方）（如果还用不了战略货舰），逆戟鲸级（高安）
高安中超过 10,000 m3 的高价值货物：偷运舰分多趟运（即使用深层空间运输舰可能更快完成，但慢慢运到总比因为被自杀式攻击而根本运不到要好）
任何地方约 60k m3 以上、约 300k m3 以下的巨量货物：战略货舰（对准比货舰快，坦度也更高）
任何地方约 300k m3 以上的巨量货物：货舰（在低安和 00 区需要护航，很容易被扰断泡/星门蹲守抓住），或战略货舰分多趟运

blocks.en: Fitting considerations for hauling ships
blocks.zh: 运输舰船的装配要点

blocks.en: The best form of tanking for haulers is not getting caught in the first place. This is especially true outside of highsec: the amount of tank in lowsec/nullsec/WH/Pochven rarely makes a difference to the outcome, because a well set up gatecamp can just spend more time getting through your ship's HP or call in reinforcements from nearby friendly pilots, while in highsec the response time of CONCORD puts an upper limit to the engagement duration. Still, fitting for maximum tank after the other crucial modules are taken care of can work against less experienced and/or single pilot attackers, giving you enough time to escape tackle, rely on damage to the attacker's ship by lowsec gate guns, or successfully burn back to the gate and jump back through. (The latter won't be an option if you used any aggressive action on your part, such as activating a Burst Jammer module, because of your own weapons timer.)
blocks.zh: 运输船最好的防御就是一开始就不被抓住。在高安以外尤其如此：在低安/00 区/虫洞/波赫文，坦度高低很少能改变结果，因为一个布置得当的星门蹲守完全可以多花点时间打穿你的 HP，或者从附近叫来友方支援；而在高安，统合部的响应时间给交战时长设了上限。尽管如此，在装好其他关键装备之后尽量堆坦度，对付经验不足和/或单人的攻击者还是有用的，能给你足够的时间摆脱拦截、借助低安星门炮对攻击者造成伤害，或者成功飞回星门再跳回去。（如果你采取了任何攻击性行为，例如开启脉冲干扰器，由于你自己的武器计时器，最后这个选项就用不了了。）

blocks.en: In all areas where warp disruption bubbles may be used (nullsec, WH space, Pochven), fitting an Interdiction Nullifier module is strongly recommended; other less-optimal options are shuttles (small cargospace, vulnerable to smartbombing gatecamps, but inherently immune to bubbles), frigates fitted for high on-grid speed (to escape from both bubbles and enemy tacklers), and cov-ops cloak capable ships such as the Astero and Stealth Bombers that can not fit the Interdiction Nullifier modules (but can by virtue of their cov-ops cloaking device move without speed penalty while cloaked).
blocks.zh: 在所有可能使用跃迁扰断泡的区域（00 区、虫洞空间、波赫文），强烈建议装配拦截失效装置；其他次优的选择有：穿梭机（货舱小，容易被使用立体炸弹的星门蹲守打掉，但天生免疫扰断泡）、装配成高网格内速度的护卫舰（可以同时摆脱扰断泡和敌方拦截船），以及能装隐秘行动隐形装置的舰船，比如阿斯特罗级和隐形轰炸舰，它们无法装配拦截失效装置（但凭借隐秘行动隐形装置，可以在隐形状态下不受速度惩罚地移动）。

blocks.en: Blockade runners rely on good bookmarks, crafty use of their Covert Ops Cloak, and not fitting anything that would increase the signature radius (no shield extenders). Due to their use of a covops cloak, well-flown blockade runners can be almost impossible to catch in highsec and lowsec. They are thus a good choice for more expensive cargo runs, but being very flimsy can easily get ganked if left uncloaked at a gate or while slow-boating from outside the docking ring of a station.
blocks.zh: 偷运舰依靠好的书签、巧妙地使用隐秘行动隐形装置，以及不装任何会增加信号半径的东西（不装护盾扩展装置）。由于使用隐秘行动隐形装置，驾驶得当的偷运舰在高安和低安几乎不可能被抓住。因此它们很适合运送较贵的货物，但它们非常脆弱，如果在星门处没有隐形，或者从空间站停靠圈外慢慢飞进去，就很容易被自杀式攻击。

blocks.en: For low-volume hauling, a ship that is fitted to align in less than 2 seconds (see Instant align for details) offers a fairly high level of protection against being intercepted by targeted warp disruption, with the added benefit that the risk your cargo is successfully scanned is also reduced. Warp disruption bubbles are still a concern however. In highsec and lowsec, the sub-1s Hecate is truly uncatchable if piloted correctly (and no game disconnects occur). For higher volumes of cargo, fit the ship to use the Cloak trick wherever possible (always on Deep Space Transports), and consider warp core stabilisers as an option if you have fitting slots to spare (highly recommended for Deep Space Transports once more, due to their innate warp core strength bonus). Outside of highsec, having a Burst Jammer module and Hornet EC-300 drones (on the few ships commonly used for hauling that have a drone bay) can work as a last-ditch effort to get yourself free from a gatecamp. Note that the Burst Jammer modules interfere with Interdiction Nullifiers, and their use in highsec is strongly discouraged due to the risk of accidentially hitting a neutral target and getting "CONCORDed".
blocks.zh: 对于小体积运输，装配成对准时间低于 2 秒的船（详见秒对准）能相当有效地防止被定向跃迁扰断拦截，额外的好处是货物被成功扫描的风险也降低了。不过跃迁扰断泡仍然是个问题。在高安和低安，对准低于 1 秒的赫卡特级只要驾驶得当（且没有掉线），是真正抓不住的。对于大体积货物，尽可能把船装配成能使用隐形技巧的配置（深层空间运输舰一定要这样），如果还有空余槽位，可以考虑装跃迁稳定器（同样强烈推荐深层空间运输舰这样做，因为它们自带跃迁核心强度加成）。在高安以外，装一个脉冲干扰器和大黄蜂EC-300无人机（少数常用于运输、带无人机挂舱的船），可以作为摆脱星门蹲守的最后手段。注意脉冲干扰器会干扰拦截失效装置，而且强烈不建议在高安使用，因为有误伤中立目标而被“统合部制裁”的风险。

blocks.en: Fitting an appropriate tank for highsec hauling
blocks.zh: 高安运输的合理坦度装配

blocks.en: The more EHP that you have, the harder it is for the attacker to blow up your ship and steal your stuff. The calculations regarding how many ships a ganker will need to use (and lose to CONCORD) to successfully destroy your ship compared to how much value the dropped cargo will likely be are a deciding factor in most highsec ganks. Considering that a cheap T1 gank ship like the Catalyst can cost as little as 2m ISK fully fitted, a common rule of thumb is to limit the value of the carried cargo plus the modules (but not rigs) fitted to the ship to less than 3000 ISK per EHP (3 million ISK per 1k EHP).
blocks.zh: 你的 EHP 越高，攻击者就越难打爆你的船、抢走你的东西。在大多数高安自杀式攻击中，决定因素是计算：攻击者需要用多少艘船（并被统合部打掉）才能成功击毁你的船，以及掉落的货物大概值多少钱。考虑到像促进级这样便宜的 T1 自杀船满配只要 2m ISK 左右，一个常见的经验法则是：把所载货物加上舰船装备（不含改装件）的价值，控制在每点 EHP 3000 ISK 以下（每 1k EHP 300 万 ISK）。

blocks.en: There are several types of tanking: buffer tanking, (shield) passive tanking and active tanking. For movements within highsec, the buffer tank is most common, as the goal is to survive the alpha strike (initial volley) of the attacking gankers and remain alive long enough for CONCORD to come and destroy the attackers. Some buffer tanks are entirely passive (no active modules), while others include active resistance modules. The active modules must be turned on after every jump; remapping them to the F1-F8 keys makes this more convenient. Still, relying on active modules for a significant part of your overall EHP carries with it the risk that you forget to turn them on in the heat of the moment.
blocks.zh: 坦克有几种类型：缓冲坦、（护盾）被动坦和主动坦。在高安内移动时，缓冲坦最常见，因为目标是扛住自杀式攻击者的第一轮齐射，并坚持到统合部赶来消灭攻击者。有些缓冲坦完全是被动的（没有主动装备），有些则包含主动抗性装备。主动装备每次跳跃后都要重新开启；把它们映射到 F1-F8 键上会方便一些。不过，如果你总 EHP 中有很大一部分依赖主动装备，就存在关键时刻忘记开启的风险。

blocks.en: T1 haulers ships are most often shield tanked to allow the low slots to be used for Expanded Cargohold modules. You will want to fit as many medium/large shield extenders into the mid slots as possible. This should be balanced with shoring up your weak EM/thermal resist holes using Multispectrum Shield Hardener modules or Shield Resist Amplifier modules (Kinetic Shield Amplifiers in case of a fit designed specifically against the common hybrid turret Catalysts used in ganking). In cases where you need more EHP and can sacrifice cargo space, consider adding a Damage Control Unit II module, Reinforced Bulkheads, or armor resist modules. A poorly fit T1 hauler will only have 4k to 6k EHP, a well fit T1 hauler can have 10k to 20k EHP without sacrificing too much cargo space.
blocks.zh: T1 运载舰通常采用护盾坦，以便把低槽留给扩充货柜舱。你会想在中槽尽可能多地装中型/大型护盾扩展装置。同时要用多谱式护盾增强器或护盾抗性增效器补上电磁/热能抗性的短板（如果是专门针对自杀式攻击中常见的混合炮塔促进级，则用动能护盾增效器）。如果你需要更多 EHP 并且可以牺牲货舱空间，可以考虑加装损伤控制 II、强化舱隔壁或装甲抗性装备。装配糟糕的 T1 运载舰只有 4k 到 6k EHP，装配得好的 T1 运载舰在不牺牲太多货舱空间的情况下可以有 10k 到 20k EHP。

blocks.en: Visibly active tanking (most notably the Multispectrum Shield Hardener) might discourage ganking by the discriminating ganker, but your capacitor will not allow you to keep them running at all times. Remember to turn them on when you align out of a gate and to turn them off once you are in warp. Turning them back on when you land at your destination gate is optional, but having them active as you land at a busy station like a trade hub is recommended.
blocks.zh: 明显可见的主动坦（最典型的是多谱式护盾增强器）可能会让挑剔的自杀式攻击者打消念头，但你的电容不允许你一直开着它们。记得在离开星门对准时开启，进入跃迁后关闭。抵达目的地星门时是否重新开启可以自行决定，但在抵达交易中心这类繁忙的空间站时，建议开着。

blocks.en: Shield tanking skills are key for the above, followed by the ability to use a Damage Control II and Multispectrum Shield Hardener II. After that, armor tanking can be considered, but that takes away cargo space quickly as you use up low slots with armor plates/hardeners instead of Expanded Cargohold modules. Note that Tech 2 Deep Space Transports and specialized Gallente haulers like the Miasmos, Epithal or Kryos are mostly useful for their specialized holds which are unaffected by Expanded Cargohold modules. These ships can, and should, be fitted with tanking, agility, or warp speed low slot modules, making armour tanked Deep Space Transports like the Impel a common sight.
blocks.zh: 护盾防御技能是上述配置的关键，其次是能够使用损伤控制 II 和多谱式护盾增强器 II。之后可以考虑装甲坦，但用装甲板/装甲强化装备占用低槽而不装扩充货柜舱，货舱空间会迅速减少。注意，T2 深层空间运输舰和盖伦特专用运载舰，如米亚莫斯级、埃比斯级或克琉斯级，主要价值在于它们不受扩充货柜舱影响的专用货舱。这些船可以、也应该在低槽装坦度、灵活性或跃迁速度装备，所以像激进级这样的装甲坦深层空间运输舰很常见。

blocks.en: For Orcas, the standard fit is a Damage Control II and Reinforced Bulkhead II in the low slots and three Large Transverse Bulkhead II rigs. This takes your ship from about 150k EHP up to about 420k EHP. The addition of some passive shield resistance amplifiers (2x EM, 1x Kinetic, 1x Thermal) will increase the EHP to about 450k even at low shield skills. Replacing the passive Amplifiers with active Hardeners adds another bit of EHP but requires more attention. Using Cargo rigs is discouraged since you lose about 170k EHP for a low amount of additional cargohold. You should train Hull Upgrades IV and Mechanics IV (or better V) before undocking. Being able to use a Damage Control II gives a nice EHP boost, and since you are almost fully hull-tank, the extra 5% from Mechanics V are also very nice. You should also consider using a Inherent Implants 'Noble' MC (Slot 8) which increases hull HP by anything from 1% up to 6%.
blocks.zh: 逆戟鲸级的标准配置是在低槽装损伤控制 II 和强化舱隔壁 II，再加三个大型横贯舱壁 II 改装件。这能让你的船从大约 150k EHP 提升到大约 420k EHP。再加上一些被动护盾抗性增效器（2 个电磁、1 个动能、1 个热能），即使护盾技能较低，EHP 也能提升到约 450k。把被动增效器换成主动强化装备还能再加一点 EHP，但需要更多操作。不建议使用货舱改装件，因为为了一点额外货舱会损失约 170k EHP。离站之前你应该练好船体加固理论 IV 和机械学 IV（最好是 V）。能用损伤控制 II 可以大幅提升 EHP，而且由于你几乎完全是结构坦，机械学 V 额外的 5% 也非常不错。你还应该考虑使用天赋植体 诺贝尔 机械学 MC 系列（8 号槽），可以增加 1% 到 6% 的结构 HP。

blocks.en: Freighters and Jump Freighters have three low slots and can fit any combination of cargohold expanders, Nanofiber Internal Structures, Inertia Stabilizers, Reinforced Bulkheads, warp speed modules, and (in the case of Jump Freighters) fuel-use reducing modules. How you fit a Freighter for highsec hauling will depend on the size of the cargo: it is strongly recommended to fit Reinforced Bulkheads whenever possible and to not fit cargohold expanders unless absolutely necessary, as the expanders will reduce your overall tank substantially. For Jump Freighters, the appropriate fit is highly dependent on which part of a typical hauling journey you are in. Pilots for both Freighters and Jump Freighters will almost always carry a full set of modules for refitting to another setup in their cargohold.
blocks.zh: 货舰和战略货舰有三个低槽，可以任意组合扩充货柜舱、纳米纤维内部构架、惯性稳定器、强化舱隔壁、跃迁速度装备，以及（战略货舰的）降低燃料消耗的装备。在高安运输时货舰怎么装取决于货物体积：强烈建议尽可能装强化舱隔壁，除非绝对必要否则不要装扩充货柜舱，因为扩充货柜舱会大幅降低总体坦度。对于战略货舰，合适的配置很大程度上取决于你处于一段典型运输旅程的哪个阶段。货舰和战略货舰的驾驶员几乎总会在货舱里带一整套装备，以便改装成另一套配置。

blocks.en: Avoiding ganking
blocks.zh: 避免自杀式攻击

blocks.en: When hauling, you should remember the following guidelines to avoid being ganked:
blocks.zh: 运输时，应该记住以下准则以避免被自杀式攻击：

en: Don't fly AFK using the autopilot
Fit your hauler well & use the right ship
Don't haul expensive cargo in a flimsy ship
Know your route, and know the most dangerous ganking spots
zh: 把运输船装配好 & 用合适的船
不要用脆皮船运贵重货物
了解你的路线，了解最危险的自杀式攻击地点
在繁忙的空间站使用离站书签

blocks.en: For further information consider reading Suicide ganking for detailed ganking and anti-ganking strategies for haulers
blocks.zh: 更多信息请阅读自杀式攻击，了解运输船相关的详细自杀式攻击和反自杀式攻击策略

blocks.en: Wardecced corp
blocks.zh: 军团被宣战

blocks.en: Never fly a Hauler ship (especially not freighters/jump freighters loaded with lots of cargo) when your corp is wardecced. You will become easy prey and will quickly get turned into ashes, together with your expensive cargo. If you need to haul during a wardec, drop the wardecced corp temporarily and fly under an NPC corp, or use an out-of corp hauler: Creating an Alt Hauler
blocks.zh: 军团被宣战时，千万不要开运载舰（尤其是装满货物的货舰/战略货舰）。你会成为轻松的猎物，很快就会连同昂贵的货物一起化为灰烬。如果你需要在战争期间运输，可以暂时退出被宣战的军团，以 NPC 军团身份飞行，或者使用不在本军团的运输小号：创建运输小号

blocks.en: AFK hauling
blocks.zh: 挂机运输

blocks.en: Flying AFK using autopilot is the #1 way that most haulers lose their ships. When you use the autopilot to fly you to your destination, it warps you to 15km from the next gate then you slowly approach the gate at 100-200 m/s (slower in a Freighter). At a minimum, this leaves you exposed for about a minute per gate and gives any potential attacker time to scan your ship, scan your cargo, then get ahead of you and setup a gank party. At worst, it gives you time to be bumped and ganked right there.
blocks.zh: 挂机开自动导航是大多数运输玩家丢船的头号原因。用自动导航飞往目的地时，它会把你跃迁到距离下一个星门 15km 的地方，然后你以 100-200 m/s（货舰更慢）的速度慢慢接近星门。这至少会让你在每个星门暴露大约一分钟，给潜在的攻击者时间扫描你的船、扫描你的货物，然后赶到你前面布置自杀式攻击。最坏的情况下，他们有时间当场把你撞开然后打爆。

blocks.en: If you must fly AFK, know your route, keep your cargo value very low, and fit as much buffer tank as possible. There are areas of space where flying AFK is reasonably safe, but the longer you do it, the higher the chances that someone will notice the pattern and try to take advantage of it.
blocks.zh: 如果你必须挂机飞，就要了解你的路线，把货物价值压得非常低，并尽可能多地装缓冲坦。有些空间区域挂机飞还算安全，但你这样做的时间越长，就越有可能有人注意到这个规律并加以利用。

blocks.en: Use the right ship & fit your ship well
blocks.zh: 用合适的船 & 把船装配好

blocks.en: Use the information in the other sections to make an informed decision on which ship to use, and what an appropriate fit for the intended journey is. Many ganks happen because a player is using an under-tanked or inappropriate ship for the job or has not considered the dangers along the route and at the destination. Remember: Both using evasion and fitting a tank to your ship counts as "tanking". Don't be tempted to haul expensive faction BPCs to a trade hub in a bulk T1 Hauler because you're already in that ship anyway to pick up Tritanium for your other industry jobs, do a separate trip for those in a fast-align ship.
blocks.zh: 利用其他章节的信息，在充分了解的基础上决定用哪艘船，以及针对这趟旅程合适的配置是什么。很多自杀式攻击之所以发生，是因为玩家用了坦度不足或不适合任务的船，或者没有考虑路线上和目的地的危险。记住：规避和给船装坦度都算“防御”。不要因为你本来就开着大容量 T1 运载舰去给其他工业项目取三钛合金，就顺便用它把昂贵的势力蓝图拷贝运到交易中心，这些东西要用快速对准的船单独跑一趟。

blocks.en: Expensive cargo
blocks.zh: 贵重货物

blocks.en: In the case of a "suicide" gank, the goal of the attacker is to trade their ship for your cargo. They do this by knowing how much ISK they will lose when their ship gets blown up by CONCORD and how much ISK your cargo is worth. Therefore your defense against a profit-minded attacker is to raise their costs while keeping the value of your cargo below the attacker's break-even point.
blocks.zh: 在“自杀式”攻击中，攻击者的目的是用自己的船换你的货物。他们清楚自己的船被统合部打爆会损失多少 ISK，也清楚你的货物值多少 ISK。因此，你对付逐利攻击者的防御手段，就是提高他们的成本，同时把货物价值控制在攻击者的盈亏平衡点以下。

blocks.en: With the commonly used 3M ISK per 1k EHP guideline, if your ship has 8k EHP, you should not be carrying more than 24M ISK worth of cargo and fit modules per trip. The more that you exceed that ISK/EHP value, the more likely you are to get ganked. However, you can often get away with 4M-6M ISK per 1k EHP if you know your route, do not auto-pilot, and know the key risk factors.
blocks.zh: 按照常用的每 1k EHP 3M ISK 准则，如果你的船有 8k EHP，每趟所载货物加装备的价值不应超过 24M ISK。超出这个 ISK/EHP 比值越多，你就越有可能被自杀式攻击。不过，如果你了解路线、不开自动导航、清楚关键风险因素，通常每 1k EHP 4M-6M ISK 也没什么问题。

blocks.en: Another alternative is the 50 million ISK maximum collateral for T1 haulers used by several hauling corporations. They will haul cargo up to 50,000,000 ISK and 17,000 m3 in size using T1 haulers. This indicates what they consider to be safe for high sec hauling in that type of ship.
blocks.zh: 另一个参考是几家运输军团对 T1 运载舰采用的 5000 万 ISK 最高抵押金。他们会用 T1 运载舰运送价值不超过 50,000,000 ISK、体积不超过 17,000 m3 的货物。这反映了他们认为这类船在高安运输时的安全范围。

blocks.en: Key risk factors (which raise/lower the ISK/EHP calculation):
blocks.zh: 关键风险因素（会提高/降低 ISK/EHP 计算值）：

en: How shiny your cargo is, and how easy it will be to carry the loot away (Having most of your value in large items such as repackaged hulls can give some less-well-set-up gankers pause, because they might not be able to carry them away if they drop as loot. Dedicated gankers will however have access to DSTs and other means of getting the loot away.)
zh: 位置（有些星系经常有人蹲守）
货物有多诱人，以及战利品有多容易被带走（如果你的大部分价值都在体积大的物品上，比如重新打包的船体，一些准备不足的自杀式攻击者可能会犹豫，因为掉落后他们可能没法把东西带走。不过专业的自杀式攻击者会有深层空间运输舰和其他运走战利品的手段。）

blocks.en: For freighters, which have about 180-200k EHP, the benchmark value is around 1-1.5B ISK. As your cargo value exceeds this range, combined with traveling through systems with a security status in the 0.5-0.6 range, it becomes more and more likely that someone will gank you for your cargo value. This is a bit of a fuzzy rule of thumb, and in the quieter portions of the galaxy with routes that take you only through 0.8 and above systems, you can get away with hauling higher value cargo loads for a very long time.
blocks.zh: 货舰大约有 180-200k EHP，基准价值约为 1-1.5B ISK。当你的货物价值超出这个范围，再加上途经安全等级在 0.5-0.6 之间的星系时，有人为了你的货物对你发动自杀式攻击的可能性就会越来越大。这只是一个比较模糊的经验法则，在银河系里较为冷清的区域，如果路线只经过 0.8 及以上的星系，你可以在很长时间内运送价值更高的货物而相安无事。

blocks.en: When you have expensive cargo above 1B ISK to be moved in a freighter, you could consider double-wrapping it (create courier contract for some other alt of yours and then create another courier contract from this alt to actual freighter pilot). It will hide the contents of this package, but some gankers tend to gank double wrapped transports without knowing what is inside, so most people (including hauling corporations) consider this to be increasing the risk rather than decreasing it. Also, most Hauling corporations will not accept double wrapped contracts any more, due to them not being able to be sub-contracted between characters - do not do this for hauling jobs you intend to contract out.
blocks.zh: 如果你要用货舰运送价值超过 1B ISK 的贵重货物，可以考虑双重打包（先给你的另一个小号创建快递合同，再由这个小号向实际的货舰驾驶员创建另一个快递合同）。这样可以隐藏包裹里的内容，但有些自杀式攻击者往往会在不知道里面是什么的情况下攻击双重打包的运输船，所以大多数人（包括运输军团）认为这样做反而增加了风险。另外，大多数运输军团已经不再接受双重打包的合同，因为这类合同无法在角色之间转包——如果你打算把运输任务外包出去，就不要这样做。

blocks.en: Know your route
blocks.zh: 了解你的路线

blocks.en: Your best friend as a hauler in high-security space is knowledge of the local terrain. Which systems tend to be camped by gank parties. Which systems see frequent kills of haulers? Where are you likely to be cargo/ship scanned? What is the security status of the systems along the route?
blocks.zh: 作为高安的运输玩家，你最好的朋友就是对当地地形的了解。哪些星系常有自杀式攻击团伙蹲守？哪些星系经常有运输船被击毁？你可能在哪里被扫描货物/舰船？路线上各星系的安全等级是多少？

blocks.en: Scouting, in low-security or null-security space, is a must-do if you are carrying anything expensive, or are not flying a blockade runner. In low-security space, a well-flown blockade runner is almost impossible to catch and it can usually get past most null-sec bubble camps.
blocks.zh: 在低安或 00 区，如果你运的东西很贵，或者开的不是偷运舰，侦察是必不可少的。在低安，驾驶得当的偷运舰几乎不可能被抓住，通常也能闯过 00 区的大多数扰断泡蹲守。

blocks.en: A useful in-game channel is Gank-Intel where the hauling community often shares info about frequently traveled routes. Asking about the current situation in there before embarking on a high value contract through a dangerous area can be invaluable.
blocks.zh: 游戏内有一个很有用的频道 Gank-Intel，运输圈经常在那里分享常走路线的情报。在穿越危险区域执行高价值合同之前，先在那里问问当前的情况，可能会非常有价值。

blocks.en: Instant dock/undock bookmarks
blocks.zh: 秒进站/秒离站书签

blocks.en: Busier market hub stations (such as Jita CNAP 4-4) will have people camping the undock 24x7, waiting for you to undock with something shiny in the cargo hold. Your #1 defense against this is to prepare an instaundock bookmark ahead of time.
blocks.zh: 较繁忙的市场中心空间站（例如 吉他 CNAP 4-4）会有人 24x7 蹲守离站点，等着你带着诱人的货物离站。对付这种情况的头号手段，就是提前准备好秒离站书签。

blocks.en: A good bookmark will get you off the station undock and out to a safe-spot before anyone has time to lock you, scan you and gank you. They are a must-have for Blockade Runners and rather important for the slower-aligning ships like Orcas and Freighters.
blocks.zh: 一个好的书签能让你在别人来得及锁定、扫描和攻击你之前，离开空间站离站点，跃迁到安全点。它们对偷运舰来说是必备的，对逆戟鲸级和货舰这类对准较慢的船也相当重要。

blocks.en: Instant docks are also essential. Occasionally when auto-docking, the game will place you outside the immediate docking radius, and you will need to slow boat into the docking radius. This is particularly problematic at Jita 4-4, where entering from Perimeter (one of the most common entry systems) will place you at the back of the station if using the "Dock" command. Several gankers make an excellent living from sitting at this area, and picking off lazy Blockade Runner pilots. Setting an Instant-Dock right as you exit the station means you are assured to warp within the docking radius and prevent an easy kill for a ganker.
blocks.zh: 秒进站书签同样必不可少。自动停靠时，游戏偶尔会把你放在停靠范围之外，你需要慢慢飞进停靠范围。这在 吉他 4-4 尤其成问题：如果从 皮尔米特（最常见的入口星系之一）进入，使用“停靠”命令会把你放在空间站的背面。好几个自杀式攻击者就靠蹲在这片区域，捡那些偷懒的偷运舰驾驶员过上了好日子。在刚离开空间站时就设置一个秒进站书签，可以确保你跃迁到停靠范围之内，不给自杀式攻击者轻松击杀的机会。

blocks.en: Use a contractor
blocks.zh: 使用中转承包人

blocks.en: The large hauling corporations all use contractor alts to assure op-sec. Essentially this means that one character accepts the contract, then sub-contracts it to the actual hauler, who carries the package, and then contracts it back the contractor who then completes the contract. This means that:
blocks.zh: 大型运输军团都会使用承包人小号来保证行动安全。基本做法是：由一个角色接下合同，然后把它转包给实际运输的玩家，由他运送包裹，再把合同转回给承包人，由承包人完成合同。这意味着：

en: Without scanning every ship, no-one (neither the contract's originator nor anyone watching the contract system) can tell which Character is hauling the package - making ganking a specific contract more difficult
As the identity (and corporation) of the actual hauler is not known, wardecs are less effective
zh: 除非扫描每一艘船，否则没人（无论是合同发起人还是关注合同系统的人）能知道是哪个角色在运这个包裹——这让针对特定合同的自杀式攻击更加困难
由于实际运输者的身份（和军团）不为人知，宣战的效果也会打折扣

blocks.en: While not strictly necessary for private haulers, this added security can sometimes be useful
blocks.zh: 虽然对个人运输玩家来说并非必需，但这种额外的安全措施有时会很有用

blocks.en: Other tips and tricks
blocks.zh: 其他技巧与窍门

blocks.en: Do not be predictable in your hauling of expensive items. Vary the time of day. Vary the route that you use. Change your ship name frequently.
blocks.zh: 运送贵重物品时不要让人摸清规律。变换出行时间，变换路线，经常更换舰船名称。

blocks.en: Hauling corporations
blocks.zh: 运输军团

blocks.en: There are several organisations in EVE which act as dedicated Hauling companies. They tend to be more reliable, more willing to take on unusual or high value requests, but also more expensive than the public contracts channel.
blocks.zh: EVE 中有几家组织是专门的运输公司。它们通常更可靠，更愿意接不寻常或高价值的委托，但也比公共合同渠道更贵。

blocks.en: Characters in EVE can use these corporations either for their own hauling needs, or consider joining them to get access to exclusive, high value contracts. If you are considering hauling as a career, the best way to make money is as part of one of these corporations.
blocks.zh: EVE 中的角色既可以委托这些军团满足自己的运输需求，也可以考虑加入它们，以获得独家的高价值合同。如果你打算把运输作为职业，最好的赚钱方式就是加入其中一家军团。

blocks.en: While not an exhaustive list, some of the most common (in no particular order) include:
blocks.zh: 以下并非完整列表，一些最常见的运输军团（排名不分先后）包括：

blocks.en: Hauler roles
blocks.zh: 运输玩法

blocks.en: Market hauling
blocks.zh: 市场运输

blocks.en: Speculative hauling is one way to make money from the market that's fairly easy to get into for a new player
blocks.zh: 投机运输是新玩家相当容易上手的一种市场赚钱方式

blocks.en: Alt hauling
blocks.zh: 小号运输

blocks.en: Setting up an alt hauler can be very useful to ship goods around during wartime when your main can't fly a hauler ship.
blocks.zh: 在战争期间你的大号没法开运输船时，准备一个运输小号来搬运货物会非常有用。

blocks.en: Courier hauling
blocks.zh: 快递运输

blocks.en: If you have a high amount of ISK to devote to collateral, courier contract hauling can be a very good way to make ISK for haulers, given that you have a freighter or jump freighter to haul around the usually large quantities of contracted goods. One billion ISK (1,000,000,000 ISK) is a good estimate of how much money you will need to get started taking courier hauling.
blocks.zh: 如果你有大量 ISK 可以用作抵押金，并且有货舰或战略货舰来运送通常数量庞大的合同货物，那么跑快递合同对运输玩家来说是一个很好的赚钱方式。开始接快递运输大约需要十亿 ISK（1,000,000,000 ISK）的启动资金，这是一个不错的估计。

blocks.en: A courier hauler can make a lot of ISK, but it's not without risk. Ganking is one problem, contract scams are another. It's always a good idea to check the contract history of an unknown contractor before accepting anything. This information can be found by opening the 'info' window of a player, clicking the three lines in the top left corner, and selecting 'Show Contracts'.
blocks.zh: 快递运输可以赚很多 ISK，但也并非没有风险。自杀式攻击是一个问题，合同诈骗是另一个问题。在接受任何合同之前，最好先查看陌生发布者的合同历史。查看方法是打开该玩家的“信息”窗口，点击左上角的三条横线，然后选择“显示合同”（Show Contracts）。

blocks.en: If you do not have docking permissions at the player-owned structure you are delivering to be aware that you can still make the delivery. You can warp to the structure, right-click and open a "transfer" window to move cargo from your ship to your item hangar in the dock-blocked structure. Before this transfer option was added a common scam was disabling docking permission after contract acceptance.
blocks.zh: 如果你在要送达的玩家建筑没有停靠权限，要知道你仍然可以完成交付。你可以跃迁到该建筑，右键打开“转移”（transfer）窗口，把货物从你的船上转移到这个禁止停靠的建筑中你的物品机库里。在加入这个转移选项之前，一种常见的骗局就是在合同被接受后关闭停靠权限。

blocks.en: Another type of scam contract that appears less suspicious at a first glance involves a valuable package and overpriced collateral. These contracts are designed to make the hauler a tempting target for random gankers so the contractor can cash in on the overpriced collateral. They can be spotted by a contract history of sending the same package (same size) back and forth between two systems along a dangerous route. It could for example be between Amarr and Dodixie, which will take the hauler through both Niarja and Uedama which are both infamous for the amount of high-sec ganking going on there. For more information on scams involving courier contracts, see the page on scams in EVE.
blocks.zh: 另一种乍看之下不那么可疑的诈骗合同，是价值高的包裹配上虚高的抵押金。这类合同的目的是让运输者成为随机自杀式攻击者眼中的诱人目标，好让发布者赚取虚高的抵押金。识别方法是查看合同历史：同一个包裹（同样体积）在一条危险路线上的两个星系之间来回运送。例如在 艾玛 和 多迪谢 之间，运输者会经过 米亚尔加 和 犹达玛，这两个星系都以高安自杀式攻击频发而臭名昭著。关于快递合同诈骗的更多信息，请参见 EVE 中的骗局页面。

blocks.en: Mining assistance
blocks.zh: 采矿辅助

blocks.en: If you're using your hauler in a mining operation (without an Orca), consider fitting a tractor beam to bring cans to you faster, as well as a salvager to make something of the inevitable rat wrecks. In addition, putting out a Mobile Tractor Unit can make it easy to pick up cans from other miners and then haul them to station (Make sure to have your drones on passive!). You could also fit a mining laser, but even a good one with pilot skills won't be getting much more than 100 m3 per minute.
blocks.zh: 如果你在采矿行动中使用运输船（没有逆戟鲸级的情况下），可以考虑装一个牵引光束，更快地把货柜拉过来，再装一个打捞器，利用难免会出现的海盗残骸。此外，放出一个移动式牵引装置可以轻松收集其他矿工的货柜，然后运回空间站（一定要把无人机设为被动！）。你也可以装一个采矿激光器，但即使是好的激光器加上驾驶员技能，每分钟的产量也不会比 100 m3 多多少。

blocks.en: Other
blocks.zh: 其他

blocks.en: Haulers can also be used to make ISK via missioning, as described for Level 4 Cargo Missions.
blocks.zh: 运输船也可以通过刷任务赚 ISK，具体见4 级运输任务。
